resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and German source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded German pass identified 25 remaining technical wording, terminology, and notation defects across Ohm's law, Joule heating, TCR, trigonometry, thermal concepts, SI units, and wire gauges; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent German human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.
